overrides.value: Shows PDFs in the Zotero reader in bionic reading mode, which bolds the first letters of each word to guide the eye. The View menu turns the mode on and off.
overrides.reason: Condensed from the "What is this?" and "Quick start" sections of README.md. The manifest description, "Bionic reading experience with Zotero.", is in English and has fewer than six words, and the GitHub About text is the same text, in English and not shown.
